quality: Inspect the actual source frames before choosing an edit; describe the subject and available text space.
Keep the user's explicit constraints ahead of any preset. Never add text, music or motion merely to fill a template.
Check framing, readable text, cut timing and intended sound on an opening preview before preparing the full export.
Separate measured media checks from reported visual/listening observations and from human approval.

clean.label: 素材を生かす
guidance: Keep the subject unobstructed and prefer simple cuts.
Do not introduce decorative text or sound without a specific request.

explain.label: 話の要点を伝える
guidance: Use verified speech timing and existing captions when requested.
Choose emphasis after inspecting the speaker and readable text area; do not invent transcript text.

rhythm.label: 音と間をそろえる
guidance: Inspect the supplied audio and meaningful visual moments before choosing accents.
Lyrics require supplied words and verified timing; a beat grid alone is not evidence of synchronization.
